roadmap.goal: Story #6251: bring the Feature Size scatter and the Feature Size Percentiles widget to a Team, each Feature sized by this Team's share (its own child Work Items under the Feature, Feature.SizeFor), and stop a Team and a Portfolio with the same id from serving each other's cached metrics. Slice 00 scopes the metrics cache by owner kind; slice 01 lifts one closed-in-range rule, adds the Team allFeaturesForSizeChart and sizePercentiles routes in a new controller, carries the share on featuresInProgress, and places the scatter frame on both owners with the Team's copy; slice 02 adds the Team featureSizePercentilesInfo route and the widget on the Team's Flow Overview. Done when every DISTILL ledger row (0.1-0.7, 1.1-1.38, 2.1-2.16) is un-ignored or un-skipped and green; `grep -rn "SCAFFOLD:" Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend` is empty; `dotnet build` has zero warnings; the backend suite is green with `--filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"`; `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` are green with zero warnings. Docs (portfolio-features.md, flow-overview.md), the release-notes line, screenshots, the evolution record and Stryker belong to finalize after the maintainer's hold and are NOT steps here.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply, deliberately. The backend is C# + NUnit 4.6 + Moq, the frontend TypeScript + Vitest + RTL; the project references no property-testing library. DISTILL authored every test, example-based, with the finite axes as [TestCase]/TestCaseSource/it.each (feature-delta.md, DISTILL 'Mandate compliance'). The crafter authors no new acceptance tests: RED is removing [Ignore(Pending)] / it.skip and watching the test fail as red-classification.md records; GREEN is production code. Existing tests are edited only where DISTILL's Existing-test disposition says so, in the same commit as the change that makes them wrong.
exit_gates: End of phase 00 and of phase 01: `grep -rn "SCAFFOLD:" Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend` is empty (00 removes the MetricsCacheKey scaffold, 01-02 the Feature.SizeFor scaffold).

End of phase 01 (AFK-3): start the backend once on the Postgres provider with demo data, call allFeaturesForSizeChart and sizePercentiles for Team Gravity (featureSizePercentilesInfo as well after phase 02), record status code and body of each in the evolution record.
End of phases 01 and 02: by-hand check with the browser throttled to a slow connection: the scatter's and the percentiles widget's loading and could-not-load looks, on a Team and on a Portfolio.
Ratification at the hold before any push: AFK-1, AFK-2, AFK-5, AFK-6, AFK-8, AFK-9, the Blocked flag from an unreadable Portfolio, and the Size column header copy question.

Backend only, releasable alone, ordered first; phase 01 depends on it only for ordering (both edit BaseMetricsService), not for behaviour.

Route every key built in GetFromCacheIfExists and every prefix in InvalidateMetrics (BaseMetricsService) through it, so all 20 colliding families are fixed at the builder, not per call site.
